lines: Vamos rever este arco: nove lugares, nove histórias.
Let’s review this arc: nine places, nine stories. Tap the lines to listen.
Em São Paulo: Planos para o futuro.
Talk about future plans with “vou” and “quero” · Future plans use “ir + infinitive” (“Vou estudar”) and “querer” (“Quero viajar”).
Em Rio de Janeiro: Dando opinião.
Give and ask for opinions politely · Give opinions with “Eu acho que…”, “Na minha opinião…”, agree with “Concordo” and disagree gently with “Não sei se concordo”.
Compare places, prices and people · Compare with “mais… que/do que”, “menos… que”, “tão… quanto”.
Make a polite phone call · Formal calls use “Bom dia, gostaria de falar com…” and “Pode repetir, por favor?”.
Invite someone and politely decline · Invite with “Quer ir…?” and decline politely with “Que pena, não posso”.
Complain politely in a restaurant · When something goes wrong, stay polite: “Desculpe, mas o prato veio frio”.
Em Rio de Janeiro: Uma despedida.
Say goodbye to a friend and exchange wishes · At an airport goodbye, Brazilians hug and say “Boa viagem!”, “Se cuida!”, “Vou sentir saudade”.
Em São Paulo: De volta ao bairro.
Return to the neighborhood and see how much you can say · Months later, you walk the same street and greet everyone.
Celebrate your two hundred episodes of Portuguese · A final party with all the neighbors celebrates 200 episodes of Portuguese.
Você já conhece nove lugares! Agora vamos praticar.
You already know nine places! Now let’s practice.
